posts.title: Harvest Moon
posts.description: Your bones say yes before your mouth does & so October unwinds days into darkness. Owls call across brown grass & moonface to hasten the fallow & what follows scurries across the plains of your November until fields scrubbed clean, raw, bleed in the cold & terrible light of day. Your hands, your eyes, your feet in this soil: so much beauty the world cannot endure.
